instruction: Have Glitch jack into the data shard and read out the contacts stored on it.

target.reason: The page offers no verb for jacking into a data shard or reading out the contacts stored on it. The available verbs are depart, say, say-to, whisper, offer, accept, and refuse, and none of them can carry out that action. Giving Glitch the shard or having Glitch speak would not perform the jack-in or the reading the instruction asks for.
